scorecard.venue: Shaheed Veer Narayan Singh International Stadium, Raipur

batting.name: FH Allen
batting.dismissal: c JM Sharma b B Kumar

batting.name: D Padikkal
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b Kartik Tyagi

batting.name: RM Patidar
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b SP Narine

batting.name: TH David
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b Kartik Tyagi

balls.text: run-out to finish the innings, and KKR end up on 192! Superb yorker on leg. Rinku cannot get under it and clinks it out to long on. Raghuvanshi chances his luck on the second but is well short, despite a dive. Top work by Padikkal from the deep, it must be said!
low full toss on the stumps. Raghuvanshi jams it out to long on and has to stay content with a single
another very full ball on leg. Rinku gets down low and heaves it towards deep backward square leg. Takes the single this time, which makes the decision off the previous ball even more puzzling
low full toss on leg. Rinku opens up his stance and tugs it towards deep mid wicket. And Rinku denies the single too. Well well.
going, going and gone! Bhuvneshwar misses the yorker by a smidgen on the shorter side. Just outside leg and Rinku wallops it a mile over deep mid wicket!
ping-point yorker outside off. Raghuvanshi jams down on it and squeezes it out behind point
low full toss on the pads. Rinku gets down low and tugs it enough to deep backward square leg's right for a couple of runs
banged in short outside off and that takes the batter by surprise. Raghuvanshi jabs at it and chops it towards short third
juicy full toss on middle and leg, but Rinku misses out. Cloths it tamely to deep mid wicket
very full outside off. Rinku throws his hands at it and slices it on the bounce to sweeper cover. The ball kicks up and nearly deceives Bethell
this is clever batting! Hazlewood misses his line on the leg-stump yorker. Rinku stays put and if anything, shuffles across to whip this past short fine leg!
oh! Full toss, tailing the batter outside leg. Rinku swishes at it and edges it towards the keeper. Nearly edged it onto his stumps
another top yorker, zoning into middle and leg. Raghuvanshi jams it back to the bowler
low full toss on middle and leg, bowled from around the wicket. Rinku flays it towards deep point
very full on middle and off. Raghuvanshi cannot get under it and drills it to long off
excellent yorker outside off. Raghuvanshi shapes for the reverse-lap but does not make contact
watch out, umpire! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi opens up his stance and bludgeons it over the bowler's head!
very full on middle and leg. Rinku squeezes it out towards deep mid wicket and is content with a single this time
low full toss outside off. Rinku plants his front foot and shanks it to long on
into the blockhole again, just outside leg. Rinku digs it out to the edge of the ring in the mid on region, and hurtles back for another brace
back of a length, following the batter outside leg. Rinku dinks it into the square leg region and he races back for another sharp brace
yorker on the pads. Rinku tucks it off his toes towards deep mid wicket and scampers across for a couple of runs
nicely done! Slower short ball outside off. Rinku reaches out for it and holds his shot long enough to slash it over short third!
full and angling into the stumps. Raghuvanshi chips it over the bowler's head
helped into the stands! Banged in short on middle and leg. Rinku walks inside the line and dumps it over the fine leg fence!
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third
short, wide and punished! A hint of width on offer. Raghuvanshi throws the lot at it and scythes it past backward point!
banged half-way down again, following the batter outside leg. Rinku slaps it towards sweeper cover

dug in short just outside off. Rinku looks for the upper-cut but is cramped for room. Seems to miss it but RCB think there may be bat involved. And RCB have gone upstairs. Jitesh did indulge in what could be termed an appeal. The ball is close to the bat, there is a flat line on UltraEdge. RCB burn a review!
back of a length, following the batter outside leg. Rinku has a swish at it and misses
fullish outside off. Raghuvanshi goes all along the ground this time but drills it straight to extra cover
this is a gorgeous shot! Flighted up on a fullish length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi gives himself room and creams it over extra cover!
pushed in full on the pads. Rinku punches it to deep mid wicket
darted in full outside off. Rinku chunks it off the inside half of the bat into the mid wicket region, and has enough time to saunter back for two
fired in full on middle and off. Driven down the ground to long off
back of a length on middle and off. Raghuvanshi rises with the bounce and jabs it to extra cover
shot! Wide half-volley and Rinku cashes in. He goes through the line and scorches it past extra cover!
very full outside off. Raghuvanshi digs it out to long on and brings up another classy half-century - this one has come off 32 balls!
right in the gap! A tad short outside off and this sits up. Raghuvanshi picks his spot and pings a pull between long on and deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Rinku has a pop at it again and shanks it to deep mid wicket
back of a length, angling across the batter outside off. Rinku hares down and swishes at it, only to miss
back of a length on middle and leg. Rinku hangs back and drops it with soft hands into the off side
shortish outside off. Rinku lets the ball come to him before running it down to deep third
back of a length, angling into the stumps. Rinku bunts it to the edge of the ring in the mid wicket region, and dashes back for two
slower ball on a full length outside off. Raghuvanshi plants his front foot and drills it to long on
full outside off. Rinku gets onto the front foot and pokes it to long on

zing bails go flying, and Green is sent packing Pace-on, back of a length on off. Zips back in a touch and Green, having an ugly hoick across the line, gets done in by the pace. Misses it completely and the ball thunders into the stumps. RCB with a timely breakthrough!
Slower ball hung up on a length wide outside off. Left alone and called a wide
greeted with a boundary! Low full toss speared into the pads. Green gets down low and smears it behind square!
Shortish outside off. Green winds up again before powering it on the bounce to long on
Back of a length on the pads. Raghuvanshi taps it to deep mid wicket. Calls for two initially but then decides to stay put
Length ball sliding down leg. Raghuvanshi misses his sweep and the umpire calls it a wide
Shortish on off. Raghuvanshi hangs back and chops it towards backward point
Back of a length on the stumps. Green sits back and heaves it towards deep mid wicket
more sloppiness in the field! Another half-tracker on the stumps. Green hacks it to long on and David makes a meal of it. Too hot to handle for him!
Green climbs into this! Dragged down on middle and off. Sits up and Green demolishes otbover wide long on!
Off-pace and dug in outside off. Raghuvanshi rides the bounce and fends it down to short third
Slower ball on a length on off. Green winds up and drags it towards deep square leg
Length ball on the pads. Raghuvanshi tucks it towards deep mid wicket
successive boundaries! A touch short again and enough width on offer. Raghuvanshi creates room and cracks it past backward point!
cleverly done! Banged in short on off. Raghuvanshi jumps up onto his toes and upper-cuts it over short fine leg!
Slower ball dug in short just outside off. Green advances and hacks at it. Inside-edges it towards short fine and scampers across
Pushed in on a length on the stumps. Green looks to go downtown and cloths it towards long off. Kohli with another misfield but the KKR batters are not alert enough to capitalize
Back of a length on middle and leg, and this holds. Raghuvanshi taken aback by it and he plonks it over the bowler
Raghuvanshi goes big! Tossed up and into the slot on the stumps. Raghuvanshi opens up his stance and thumps it over deep square leg!
Slanted in on a length on leg. Green tugs it towards deep mid wicket
Shorter and wider outside off. Cut towards deep point
Tossed up full on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi presses forward and drives it into the off side
dug in shorter outside off. Green tries to tonk it into tomorrow and only swats a few flies in the process
full and angling into the pads. Raghuvanshi works it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball on a length outside off. Chopped on the bounce to backward point
through the gap! Nice, flowing drive. Raghuvanshi steps forward to this full ball outside off and eases it between mid off and extra cover!
dug in short outside off. Green has a wild mow across the line and drags it behind square
into the blockhole just outside off. Dug out towards backward point, where Kohli fumbles and ends up conceding a single
flighted up a touch, and bowled full on off. Driven down the ground to long off
back of a length on middle and off. Green jabs it to extra cover, where Patidar misfields and ends up conceding a single
the bouncer is out now. Banged in on middle and leg. Green ducks under it. Called one bouncer for the over
back of a length on the stumps. Eased down the ground to long on
back of a length on leg. Green works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length in and around off. Punched off the back foot towards long off
back of a length on middle and leg. Raghuvanshi is late on the flick and the ball pings off the thigh pad behind square
back of a length on off. Raghuvanshi gets up onto his toes and jabs it towards backward point
back of a length on middle and off. Green dinks it into the mid wicket region. Thinks about two but Bethell is swift off his mark to deny it
edged and four! This is a beauty. On a back of a length in the channel. Green is forced to play at it but the ball straightens to kiss the outside edge and fly to the keeper's right!
angled in full on middle and off. Raghuvanshi comes forward and knocks it to long on
zipped in full on off. Green tips it to mid off and hares across to the other end
slower short ball on middle and leg. Cuts in to cramp Green backing away, and he taps it into the off side to keep strike
hard length just outside off. Nips in, skids through and Raghuvanshi fends it behind point
four more! Back of a length on off. Raghuvanshi lets the ball come to him before tugging it behind square. Deep square had no chance!
back of a length outside off, shaping away. Green reaches out for it and jabs it towards deep point
back of a length just outside off. Green gets up on his toes and defends
oh! Back of a length outside off and this zings back in. Green jabs at it and gets done in on the inside
back of a length outside off. Green gets half forward and dabs it towards deep backward point
hard length outside off and this nips back in sharply. Green plays all around it and gets struck on the back thigh

goes straight up, and Rahane's fun is over! Banged into the track just outside off. Rahane looks for the pull but is awfully late on the stroke. Pops up off the top edge and Hazlewood completes the most regulations of return catches. Hazlewood into the act early!
more runs! Back of a length outside off. Rahane shuffles across, shapes for the scoop and helps it past the keeper. Given as runs!
short and wide outside off. Rahane has a big waft at it and only connects with fresh air
back of a length just outside off. Raghuvanshi dabs it to short third and gets called through by his skipper
fetch this too, says Rahane! Marginally short outside off. Rahane picks it up and hoists it just over the deep mid wicket fence!
nicely done! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Rahane waits on it and then opens his bat face late to steer it past backward point!
fullish outside off. Rahane establishes a solid base and powers it on the bounce to mid off
shortish outside off. Raghuvanshi rides the bounce and runs it down to deep backward point
angled in full, following the batter outside leg. Raghuvanshi misses his flick and the ball rolls off his pad into the off side. A bit of a mix-up but no damage done
picked up, and dispatched! A touch short outside off. Raghuvanshi spots the length early, stands tall and whacks it over the wide long on fence!
back of a length on off. Raghuvanshi gets up on his toes and punches it through cover point. David chases after it and eventually gets there
back of a length, nipping in to middle and off. Raghuvanshi has a poke at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his body
back of a length outside off. Raghuvanshi skips down the track before shouldering arms

nicked and gone! Bhuvi has the last laugh, and Allen is outta here! Back of a length in the channel and this threatens to angle in before straightening off the pitch. Allen is squared up as he wafts at it and can only feather it through to the keeper. Big, big wicket for RCB, and the crowd finds its voice!
lovely! Back of a length outside off. Allen stands up tall on the back foot and threads it between mid off and extra cover!
back of a length, drifting into the hips. Rahane tucks it towards deep backward square leg
length just outside off and this shapes away late too. Allen hangs back and meets it right under his eyes
Allen on the charge! Shortish and angling into off. Allen picks the length early, opens up his front hip and hammers it past mid wicket!
up, up and away now! Length ball outside off. Allen plants his front foot, covers the swing and slams it over mid off!
shot! Right out of the top drawer. Back of a length outside off. Allen rises with the bounce and caresses it between extra cover and mid off!
shortish just outside off. Allen swings for the hills and jams it off the inside edge into his body
back of a length outside off and this shapes away late. Allen goes feeling for it away from his body and gets beaten on the outside
off the mark in pristine fashion! Fullish in the channel and this is an outstanding shot. Rahane presses forward, shows the maker's name and cracks it between extra cover and mid off!
back of a length outside off, shaping away. Rahane comes half forward and pats it into the off side
slower ball on a length outside off, and this knuckle ball seems to shape away too. Rahane nibbles at it and misses
oh! Fullish in the channel and this nips back in. Rahane walks down the track and plays outside the line. Gets pinged on the back leg but that might have been too high
fullish just outside off and this also shapes in a touch. Rahane gets onto the front foot and pokes it back to the bowler
full and angling into the batter on middle and off. Rahane comes forward and defends

one ball is all Jitesh needs! RCB cruise past KKR, and return to the top of the table! Half-tracker outside off. Jitesh lines it up and swats it to long on's right. Kohli takes off his helmet and soaks in the applause and appreciation. Looks up to the heavens too, and this has been a heavenly knock. Hugs and handshakes in the RCB camp - they have seen their talisman turn up, and they now go above the Titans on the points table too!
banged in short outside off. Jitesh swings at it and seems to clink it off the toe-end towards the keeper

full toss on the pads and Kohli misses out. Fails to make contact with his whip and the ball rolls off the pad into the on side. And KKR review for the lbw because, well, why not. Don't think there is anything in this, but since they have a review left, they might as well. Bat involved, says UltraEdge, and on we go!
full, wide and sliced away! Kohli uses the angle, peels the outer cover off the ball and knifes it past cover point!
very full outside off. Jitesh digs it out towards long off

a hundred to savour! The chasemaster doing chasemaster things again, and this has been a knock right out of the top drawer! Full toss outside off. Kohli jams it down the ground and brings up a 58-ball 100 to make a potentially tricky chase look rather routine!
full outside off. Jitesh drives it to deep extra cover and that is the most-cheered single of the evening (so far)
back of a length on middle and off. Jitesh helps it to deep mid wicket and keeps strike

oh my days - what a sensational catch that is! An absolute worldie! Shortish just outside off. David backs away and flays it towards backward point. Pandey flies to his left, lunges down low and somehow makes it stick. The crowd is shocked. The bowler cannot believe it either. Not sure anyone watching can believe it either. The ball was almost behind Pandey as he flung out his left mitt, and he grasped it beautifully. There is a check on to see if the catch is fair. Third umpire says the catch is clean, and this might go down as one of the greatest IPL catches of all time!
back of a length outside off. Kohli looks to bunt it away and plonks it off the leading edge towards backward point
this is a Kohli special! Right in the slot on middle and leg. Kohli snaps his wrists into play again and whips it over deep mid wicket. All class!
slower short ball on leg. Kohli a tad early into his pull and drags it to short fine leg
banged in short. David gets into position and hacks it to mid wicket
back of a length on leg. David stays back and knocks it to long on
darted down leg. David misses and the keeper parries it to short fine. Kohli calls for the single before sending his partner back. No damage done
length ball on middle and leg. Kohli turns it into the mid wicket region
play that on repeat all night long! This is just...sumptuous. Fullish on middle and off. Kohli gets close enough to it and creams it with a straight bat into the sightscreen!
back of a length on off. Kohli gets on top of the bounce and punches it past extra cover for a couple of runs
short ball and Kohli makes merry! Too much time for Kohli and he picks his spot to bulldoze this to deep mid wicket's right!
flighted up full on middle and leg. Kohli lunges forward and plays it back to the bowler

Patidar shanks one, and Rahane holds on, after multiple attempts! Back of a length on middle and off. This spins away and Patidar, swishing wildly at it, skews it up. Rahane settles under it at extra cover and after 7-8 bites at the cherry, eventually clings on. Ball landed on his stomach in the end as he fell to the turf, and Rahane will be grateful it did!
right out of the screws! Back of a length on the stumps. Sits up invitingly and Patidar whacks it out of sight. Clean over deep mid wicket!
fuller on middle and off. Kohli opens his bat face and nurdles it into the point region
brilliant batting! Marginally short outside off. Kohli rocks back and clobbers it into the gap between long on and deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Holds in the pitch and Kohli scuffs it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Patidar makes room and cuts it off his stumps towards sweeper cover
vintage Kohli! Arora misses his mark and pays the price. On the stumps and Kohli snaps his wrists into action to pummel it to long on's right!
slower ball pushed across the batter a mile outside off. Kohli tries to reach it by shuffling across but fails to do so. Called a wide nevertheless
full toss outside off. Patidar looks to launch it over mid on but clinks it off the bottom half of the bat towards mid on

slower bumper outside off. Patidar looks for the upper-cut but seems to get beaten by the lack of pace. Looks like Patidar has reviewed this, arguing it should be a wide on height. And he might have a case too. Top of Patidar's head is measured at 1.81m and this is passing through at 1.918m. No bat involved either, and the wide has been called now.
off-pace and dug in short outside off. Kohli skips down and drags it to deep mid wicket
slower ball on a length wide outside off. Kohli shimmies across a touch and then swipes across the line. Misses it completely
timed to perfection! Low full toss outside off. Kohli knows long off is wide and he closes his bat face enough to drill it to long off's right!
nails the wide yorker first up. Kohli tries to dig it out but only scrapes a piece of the turf, rather than the ball
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Kohli turns it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball on a back of a length on the hips. Patidar eases it into the leg side
another short ball on off, this one at 142.3kph. Patidar looks for the pull but he is awfully late on the pull. Ball whistles past his helmet this time
ouch! Bumper on off, bowled at 141.4kph, and this climbs through. Patidar takes his eyes off it and the ball cracks into the back of his helmet. Hope Patidar is alright - that seemed a nasty blow!
full and angling into the pads. Patidar tucks it past mid wicket and opens his account

slapped straight to extra cover, and Tyagi breathes life into this contest! Back of a length outside off. Padikkal backs away and throws the lot at it. Smashes it but smashes it straight down Rahane's throat. RCB's big partnership is broken, and the door is slightly ajar for KKR now!
slower short ball on off. Padikkal rolls his wrists and helps it towards deep backward square leg
dug in short outside off. Kohli forehands it down the ground to long on
slanted in full on middle and leg, Kohli places it enough to deep mid wicket's left and canters back for two
back of a length, angling into the pads. Kohli glances it behind square and saunters back for a couple of runs
back of a length on the hips. Padikkal tucks it towards deep mid wicket
short, wide and flayed away! Another hit-me ball. Padikkal unleashes his fury and slashes it over backward point!
back of a length on the stumps. Padikkal stabs it to deep mid wicket
fullish on leg, and this spins in. Padikkal, tucked up for room, prods it into the on side
back of a length outside off and this spins away. Padikkal has a nibble at it and edges it on the bounce to short third
back of a length, pitching outside off and spinning towards the stumps. Kohli shanks it to long on
back of a length outside off. Padikkal has a swipe at it and chalks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Kohli stays back and pushes it enough to extra cover's left for a single
finds the gap, and finds the fence! Another drag-down outside leg. Padikkal hops back and belts it between deep square leg and deep mid wicket!
back of a length on middle and leg. Eased out into the leg side
very full outside off. Flicked down the ground to long on

fired across the batter outside off. Padikkal shapes for the reverse and misses it again. Called a wide this time. Raghuvanshi whips off the bails, though, and we go upstairs to check if there is any merit in the appeal. Absolutely noyhing in it, and Padikkal stays!
back of a length, following Kohli outside leg. Jabbed out towards sweeper cover
shot! Marginally short on middle and leg. Kohli rocks back in a flash and pounds it over mid wicket!
shortish on the hips. Pulled away to deep backward square leg
yet another fifty in a run-chase for Kohli! Short ball on off. Kohli rides the bounce and pulls it between deep backward square leg and deep mid wicket to bring up his milestone!
slower ball on a back of a length on off. Padikkal stays leg side and dabs it towards backward point
hard length, angling into leg. Kohli tucks it towards deep mid wicket
off the middle of the bat this time! This is a half-tracker. Sits up outside off and Kohli, on top of the bounce, hammers it to deep mid wicket's right!
safe! Banged half-way down outside off. Kohli has a swipe at it and miscues it towards deep backward square leg. Back for another brace
slower ball on a back of a length on off. Kohli dinks it to the edge of the ring in the mid on region and calls for two. Scampers back to complete it
dragged down just outside off. Kohli hops back and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket
no review needed for this one. Speared in full outside leg. Keeper fumbles too and RCB get two more bonus runs

back of a length, pushed across the batter wide outside off. Padikkal misses his reverse and the umpire is happy with the line. Padikkal looks at Kohli and then reviews. This may have been beyond the tramlines but will Padikkal attempting the reverse change the dynamics? Nothing inside the tramlines, and the wide has been called, despite Padikkal shaping for the reverse and missing it
back of a length on middle and leg. Kohli works it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Kohli lets it go and he gets the wide call. Seemed touch-and-go, but the umpire went with the wide
shortish outside off and this sticks in the surface. Padikkal punches it to long off
back of a length outside off. Kohli backs away and slaps it to long off
back of a length, angling into the pads. Straightens a touch and Kohli plonks it towards the bowler
fired in on a length on middle and off. Jabbed out to extra cover
dug in short outside off. Kohli gets on top of the bounce and short-arm-jabs it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball hung up on a length wide outside off. Left alone and called a wide

dropped again - oh dear! This is an absolute sitter. Banged in short on the stumps. Padikkal miscues his pull and hits it straight to Arora at deep backward square leg. Arora, though, shells it. Green cannot believe it
slower ball on a length on off. Kohli has a poke at it and chunks it off the inside edge behind square
angled into the stumps. Padikkal nudges it into the mid wicket region and Green tears after it to prevent the second
Padikkal joins in on the fun too! Slot ball outside off. Padikkal plants his front foot and bashes it over mid off!
hard length on middle and off. Kohli punches it to long on
back of a length outside off. Kohli reaches out for it and chops it off the under-edge towards short third
tossed up full outside off. Padikkal stretches forward and drives it towards long off
flighted up full outside off. Kohli gets down on one knee and hacks it on the bounce to long on
back of a length and this straightens after pitching. Kohli reads it off the pitch and defends
back of a length on middle and off. Kohli goes right back and dinks it into the gap between deep mid wicket and deep square leg. Back for a brace
back of a length outside off. Punched off the back foot to extra cover
back of a length just outside off and this skids through. Padikkal looks to dab it behind point but is beaten for pace
off-pace and dug into the track just outside off. Padikkal tries to force it through the off side but ends up scuffing it back to the bowler
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Kohli dabs it behind point and keeps things ticking
picked up and deposited! Shortish on the hips. Kohli swivels inside the line, lifts up his front leg and helps it well over the long leg fence. Bowled at 142.9kph. Probably went off the bat quicker!

palmed over the bar! Back of a length outside off. Kohli throws the lot at it and drives it uppishly towards extra cover. Powell leaps up, gets both hands to it but the ball bursts through. That will go down as a drop!
length outside off. Kohli plants his front foot and smashes it on the bounce to mid off
back of a length delivery wide outside off. Kohli lets it go and the umpire calls it a wide
shot! Back of a length outside off. Padikkal seems to pick the one going away and threads it between cover point and extra cover!
loose ball and punished! Dragged down outside leg. Padikkal rocks back and swipes it past short fine leg!
away-going ball, on a back of a length outside off. Kohli goes back and tugs it to long on
back of a length on the pads. Padikkal looks to work to leg and helps it towards short fine, albeit off the pad
back of a length outside off. Padikkal reads it off the pitch and dabs it towards short third
flighted up full just outside off. Kohli lunges at it and turns it into the square leg region
dug in much shorter on off. Padikkal shapes for the upper-cut but is beaten for pace
another brutish short ball, bowled at 141.9kph. On middle and leg and Padikkal, jumping around, fends it into the ground
short, wide and too easy! Padikkal has all the time in the world to throw his hands at it and blitz it through cover point!
off the mark instantly! Shortish on the hips. Padikkal uses the pace and glances it into the fine leg fence!

a snorter at almost 144kph, and Bethell has to depart! Shortish on middle and leg. Climbs through on Bethell and he gets cramped for room on the pull. Nowhere to go and the ball spoons up off the splice. Kisses the helmet before looping up definitively and the bowler does the rest. Bethell's chain also falls off, and RCB's opening partnership has been broken in the fourth over!
back of a length outside off. Kohli tips it to mid off and dashes across to the other end
back of a length on middle and leg. Kohli glances it to short fine leg and saunters across to keep strike
back of a length outside off. Bethell rides the extra bounce and guides it towards deep backward point
back of a length outside off. Bethell lets the ball come to him before dabbing it towards backward point
the runs are flowing now! And to be fair, this is a hit-me ball. Short and wide, and Bethell thunders it through cover point!
what timing! Back of a length outside off. Bethell hops up onto his toes and times it sweetly past point. Sweeper had no chance either!
this is a tremendous shot! Fullish and angling into off. Bethell walks down the track, stays still thereafter and pops it over mid on with minimal fuss!
four more! Back of a length and straying onto the pads. Kohli uses the pace on offer and tickles it into the fine leg fence!
short, wide and put away too! Sits up nicely and Kohli rises with the bounce to crash it over the off-side ring!
trademark Kohli! Full and sliding into the pads. Kohli gets forward, snaps his wrists into action and whips it uppishly behind square!
on a length on leg and this skids through. Bethell is late on his push and the ball cannons off the back thigh into the off side
slanted in on a length on middle and leg. Kohli plays all around his flick and the ball dribbles off his thigh pad into the on side
in-swinger, bowled full on off, and Kohli helps himself to a boundary! Rolls his wrists nicely and clips it past mid wicket!

length ball on middle and leg, shaping into Kohli. He nudges it into the mid wicket region and does what he was unable to do in his previous two games - get off the mark. And Kohli responds with a fist pump too!
back of a length in the channel and this decks back in sharply. Bethell is cut in half and the ball jams off the thigh pad behind point
another peach! Back of a length outside off. Bethell takes a step down and nibbles at it, only to get beaten on the outside
